messages:
rachel: Quick spike result — I sketched a state-machine for the CP handshake and a short recovery playbook. Posting so we can iterate before the RFC follow-up.

mike: nice. can you paste the state diagram here?

rachel: sure — simplified: ```
INIT -> AUTH_REQUEST -> AUTH_VERIFIED -> CONFIG_SYNC -> READY
if any step times out -> RETRY (backoff) -> if retries exhausted -> QUARANTINE + alert
```

javier: question: what counts as "timeout" vs "failure" for AUTH_VERIFIED? e.g., 401 vs network timeout.

rachel: good call. my proposal: 401/403 = hard-fail -> immediate QUARANTINE and customer-visible error, network timeout = soft-fail -> RETRY with exponential backoff and degraded mode if CONFIG_SYNC not reached.

sophia: degraded mode details? do we allow reads-only to CP or route to fallback regional relay?
achel: prefer fallback regional relay for reads, and block writes that change customer routing config. that keeps control invariants.

leo: for QUARANTINE, what manual ops are required? we should list steps to unblock: 1) check certs 2) inspect auth logs 3) run `cp-handshake-diagnostics` script 4) re-init handshake.

rachel: adding that to playbook. also want automatic remediation where safe: if cert expiry detected -> trigger rotation job; if transient auth backend error -> auto-retry after rotation attempt.

mike: +1 for automated cert rotation. but need RBAC audit header recorded before rotation attempt.

javier: on the topic of retries: do we bound token leak surface? repeated retries can trigger rate limits on customer side. suggest capped retries per minute per tenant and circuit-breaker to switch to fallback relay.
sophia: agreed. add per-tenant rate limit and a global circuit breaker metric (error rate over 5m).

rachel: pseudo-config I sketched: ```yaml
handshake:
  timeout_ms: 12000
  retry_policy: { initial_backoff_ms: 500, max_backoff_ms: 30000, max_retries: 5 }
  hard_fail_codes: [401,403,404]
  fallback: regional_relay
  quarantine_ttl_minutes: 30
```

leo: please add observability hooks for every state transition and include the root_cause tag when we move to QUARANTINE. ops pager should include tenant_id + last_error.achel: will do. also adding a `handshake.history` KV for last 5 states for debugging.

mike: small ops concern: quarantine_ttl 30m might be too short for some enterprise customers where manual verification required. make it configurable per-account and have default 30m.
achel: agreed — default 30m, enterprise accounts can increase via tenant settings. note in RFC.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: cp-handshake-state-machine v0.1 -> staging (triggered by rachel) :rocket:

javier: last thought: we should include a migration path for historical endpoints that expect legacy handshake shape. maybe a compatibility mode flag on regional_relay to accept old token formats for N months.
sophia: document compatibility flag and expiry policy in RFC draft.

rachel: thanks all — I'll update the draft with these items and drop a follow-up thread with the RFC link. feel free to DM if you want to pair on the recovery playbook. :thumbsup:
